title: The Royal Bathroom
style: Hyper-realistic 3D Pixar-style animation, fruit-headed people with human bodies, cinematic lighting, cozy lake-house setting, vertical 9:16

characters.kiki: Kiki, a man with a fuzzy brown kiwi fruit for a head (big expressive eyes, subtle smirk), wearing a grey hoodie and jeans
characters.pearl: Pearl, a woman with a soft pink-orange peach for a head (rosy blush, glossy lips, oversized sunglasses pushed up), wearing a white sundress and a big straw sun hat
characters.parents: an older couple with a cantaloupe head and a honeydew melon head, wearing matching cardigans
characters.kids: a crowd of small children with blueberry heads in colorful swimsuits

shots.image: Extreme close-up of a toilet paper roll on a holder in a dim bathroom, dramatic spotlight, dust in the air
shots.motion: Slow dramatic push-in on the toilet paper roll, light flickers once
shots.vo: Five days. Fourteen family members. One vacation house. And the sweetest revenge of my life cost me absolutely nothing.

shots.image: Aerial view of a huge wooden lake house at golden hour, several cars pulling into the driveway
shots.motion: Drone shot slowly circling the house as cars arrive
shots.vo: Every year my whole family rents a huge house together. We live ten hours apart, so this is the one week we're all under one roof.

shots.image: {kids} pouring out of a minivan onto a lawn, {parents} laughing and waving behind them
shots.motion: Kids run excitedly toward the camera, parents wave
shots.vo: Parents, siblings, nieces, nephews, from age 1 to age 25.

shots.image: {pearl} bursting through the front door of the lake house dragging four suitcases, sunlight behind her
shots.motion: She struts in confidently, hair and hat bouncing, suitcases rolling behind her
shots.vo: My sister Pearl got there first. She always gets there first.

shots.image: Luxurious bedroom with a king bed, big window over a lake, and an open door to a private marble bathroom, glowing heavenly light
shots.motion: Camera glides into the room, golden light rays shimmer
shots.vo: She claimed the best room. Big bed. Lake view. Private bathroom.

shots.image: {pearl} sitting on the king bed sipping a smoothie, looking at {kiki} who stands in the doorway holding a backpack
shots.motion: Pearl gestures politely with her smoothie; Kiki opens his mouth, then closes it
shots.vo: PEARL: I'm totally open to hearing why you should have this room. Go ahead.

shots.image: {kiki} sitting on creaky basement stairs under a single bare bulb, talking to the camera like a reality TV confessional
shots.motion: Bulb flickers, Kiki shrugs and speaks to camera
shots.vo: KIKI: She had me. Zero arguments. Fair's fair.

shots.image: Small basement bedroom with a tiny window, a plain bed, one flickering bulb, a cute cartoon spider in the corner
shots.motion: Kiki walks in and looks around; the spider waves one leg, Kiki waves back
shots.vo: My room was in the basement. It was fine. Just... no bathroom.

shots.image: {kiki} in a hallway bathroom doorway, eyes going wide in shock
shots.motion: Fast zoom onto Kiki's shocked eyes, then freeze
shots.vo: Until day two, when I discovered the secret of the house.

shots.image: {kiki} holding up a thick, fluffy, quilted toilet paper roll that glows golden in a clean bathroom
shots.motion: Kiki lifts the roll slowly, golden sparkles float around it
shots.vo: The house had the good toilet paper. Soft. Fluffy. Classy.

shots.image: {kiki} peeking through a cracked door into a marble private bathroom; on the holder, a thin, see-through single-ply roll
shots.motion: Kiki pokes the thin roll with one finger; it crinkles like sandpaper; he recoils
shots.vo: Every bathroom had the good stuff. Every bathroom... except one.

shots.image: {kiki} on the basement stairs confessional, a slow sly smile spreading across his face
shots.motion: Long pause, then a slow smile, then a small shrug
shots.vo: KIKI: A good brother would have said something. ... Anyway.

shots.image: Summer vacation montage: {kids} splashing in a lake, the melon dad burning burgers on a grill, a board game night
shots.motion: Fun quick cuts of splashing, smoke from the grill, laughing
shots.vo: And because her bathroom was so convenient, she never once used another one. Five days.

shots.image: {pearl} walking out of her private bathroom a little stiffly, slightly uncomfortable expression; {kiki} at the dinner table in the background sipping lemonade, watching her
shots.motion: Pearl walks awkwardly; Kiki's eyes follow her without blinking as he sips
shots.vo: PEARL: Is it just me, or is this house kind of... rough? KIKI: Rough? I think it's lovely.

shots.image: The whole fruit family hugging goodbye in the driveway at sunset, {pearl} and {kiki} in front
shots.motion: Group hug, Pearl waves, Kiki gives a knowing smile
shots.vo: PEARL: Same house next year? KIKI: Absolutely. And you should definitely take the same room.

shots.image: {kiki} on the basement stairs confessional holding a fluffy toilet paper roll up like a trophy
shots.motion: He raises the roll triumphantly and winks at the camera
shots.vo: KIKI: So yes, Pearl. Enjoy your private bathroom. And your crappy toilet paper.
